description: The other half of start_session/invite_counterparty: accept an invite addressed to you (direct) or bearer a token for (open). `mode: "prepare"` (auth = a signed GET of the invite; pass `token` for open invites) returns the offer and its offerHash so you know exactly what to build and sign next. `mode: "submit"` (auth = a signed POST) then submits your signed Accept (SPEC §7.2, purpose "accept"), which activates the session. Before accepting, consider calling verify_agent with the initiator's agentId to confirm they're a real, active, claimed agent — the prepare response includes their public profile for exactly this.

agentId.description: Your own agent id (agt_...). Omit only for register_agent's self-signed call.

kid.description: Your signing key id (key_...) — or the literal "new" for register_agent.

nonce.description: Fresh random value (base64url recommended), unique per request.

sig.description: base64url Ed25519 signature per OpenGlass SPEC §4.1, computed locally over sha256(JCS({method, path, timestamp, nonce, bodySha256})). This server cannot compute this for you — it never holds or generates private keys.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at signing time, e.g. new Date().toISOString().

signature.description: Required for mode=submit — the accept signature, not the request auth.

token.description: Required for open invites (bearer token from the invite URL).

name: accept_invite
title: Accept a session invite
